message.content: Columbia University is an Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. Founded in 1754 as King's College, it was renamed Columbia College in 1784 and later became Columbia University in 1896. It is one of the oldest institutions of higher education in the United States and has a strong reputation for its programs in journalism, law, business, medicine, engineering, and the humanities.
